summary: Blue Owl Capital Corp II filed an 8-K announcing a $0.62 per share return of capital distribution for Q3, representing 7.5% of NAV as of Dec 31, 2025, exceeding its 5%-of-NAV-per-quarter target. The distribution will be paid on or before July 22, 2026 to shareholders of record as of July 21, 2026. Combined with prior distributions, the company will have returned ~43% of year-end 2025 NAV ($3.54/share) over four months. The board declared this capital-return event without an advisor. The filing reflects an accelerated return-of-capital strategy, with a goal of returning 50% or more of year-end 2025 NAV by year-end 2026. Watch for further sizable distributions and portfolio repayment pace, noting possible NAV erosion. No risk-arb angle as this is a return of capital, not a merger.
